milestones.title: PPWR applies
milestones.note: Declarations of conformity, technical files and core packaging data for every packaging placed on the EU market.

milestones.title: UK deposit return scheme
milestones.note: In-scope drinks cans and PET bottles carry a deposit; container volume and scheme status are needed per product.

milestones.title: PPWR harmonised labelling
milestones.note: Harmonised sorting labels and a data carrier on packaging.

milestones.title: PPWR recyclability grades and recycled content
milestones.note: Packaging must reach a recyclability grade, and plastic packaging needs minimum recycled content.

milestones.title: SB 54 targets
milestones.note: All single-use packaging recyclable or compostable, 65% of plastic packaging recycled, 25% plastic source reduction.
